progression.narrative: The performance opens on B2 and dwells most on B in Kereshmeh-e Rak. Safir-e Rak (0:31.9) introduces D#, Ek, F#, centred on B. The line peaks at C#5 (554.8 Hz) at 0:21.5. It closes on F#4, not the tonic (Ek4 → C#4 → C#4 → D#4 → B3 → F#4).
